intent_movement: Monitor BTC regime hypotheses and falsify weak operational interpretations before they become operational claims, starting from Alipio's timeframe question and derived POC/Kumo/feed-robustness method candidates.

left.purpose: Current plane, direction and request status.

center.purpose: Intent, observables, baseline/null and first smoke.

right.purpose: Cycle trace, skipped movements and accepted surface.
Answer from domain state and runtime context.

it.campo: Stato BTC, dati disponibili e decisione corrente.
it.grafo: Relazioni tra claim, timeframe, baseline e falsifier.
it.bicono: Poli delle ipotesi estratti dalle letture.
it.tassonomia: Sequenza dei cicli e movimento del regime lab.
it.prodotti: Claim-card, watchlist, reject reason e verifiche.

en.campo: BTC state, available data and current decision.
en.grafo: Relations across claims, timeframes, baselines and falsifier.
en.prodotti: Claim-cards, watchlist, reject reasons and checks.

teorie.title: Metodi
teorie.body: Famiglie operative tradotte in osservabili: volume profile, POC/LVN/HVN, FVG, CME gap, trendline, feed robustness.
teorie.logic: Nessun metodo vale come autorita': entra solo se ha definizione meccanica, data-card e null coerente.

ponti.title: Confluenze
ponti.body: Punti in cui piu' letture BTC si incontrano sullo stesso livello, timeframe o confine osservabile.
ponti.logic: Una confluenza non e' un segnale: deve sopravvivere a feed, timeframe, baseline e controllo anti-lookahead.

vuoti.title: Gap
vuoti.body: Inefficienze candidate: FVG, low-volume node, CME gap o area non ancora definita da dati robusti.
vuoti.logic: Un gap resta ipotesi finche' non e' localizzato, datato, versionato e falsificato contro un null appropriato.

scoperte.title: Claim-card
scoperte.body: Schede leggibili che dichiarano claim, fonte, timeframe, data-card, evidenza e motivo della decisione.
scoperte.logic: Output utile: watch, test, reject o roadmap; mai buy/sell/target.

applicazioni.title: Watchlist
applicazioni.body: Claim non promossi che meritano osservazione o un prossimo test dichiarato.
applicazioni.logic: La watchlist conserva possibilita' senza trasformarle in segnali operativi.

prodotti.title: Verifiche
prodotti.body: Output maturi solo dopo data-card, baseline/null, feed robustness e revisione del confine no-signal.
prodotti.logic: Il Bitcoin Lab puo' produrre monitoraggio e falsificazione, non consulenza finanziaria.

cicli.title: Letture
cicli.body: Cicli cognitivi del Lab: raccolgono dati, generano una claim-card, attaccano l'ipotesi e aggiornano il seme.
cicli.logic: Ogni lettura deve lasciare runtime trace e memoria di cosa non puo' essere promosso.

teorie.title: Methods
teorie.body: Operational families translated into observables: Volume Profile, POC/LVN/HVN, FVG, CME gap, trendline and feed robustness.
teorie.logic: No method is authoritative by itself: it enters only with a mechanical definition, data-card and coherent null.

ponti.title: Confluences
ponti.body: Where multiple BTC readings meet on the same level, timeframe or observable boundary.
ponti.logic: A confluence is not a signal: it must survive feed checks, timeframe checks, baseline and anti-lookahead control.

vuoti.title: Gaps
vuoti.body: Candidate inefficiencies: FVG, low-volume node, CME gap or an area not yet defined by robust data.
vuoti.logic: A gap remains a hypothesis until it is localized, dated, versioned and falsified against an appropriate null.

scoperte.title: Claim-cards
scoperte.body: Readable cards declaring claim, source, timeframe, data-card, evidence and decision reason.
scoperte.logic: Useful output: watch, test, reject or roadmap; never buy/sell/target.

applicazioni.title: Watchlist
applicazioni.body: Unpromoted claims that deserve observation or a declared next test.
applicazioni.logic: The watchlist preserves possibilities without turning them into operational signals.

prodotti.title: Checks
prodotti.body: Mature outputs only after data-card, baseline/null, feed robustness and review of the no-signal boundary.
prodotti.logic: The Bitcoin Lab can produce monitoring and falsification, not financial advice.

cicli.title: Readings
cicli.body: Cognitive Lab cycles: collect data, generate a claim-card, attack the hypothesis and update the seed.
cicli.logic: Each reading must leave a runtime trace and memory of what cannot be promoted.

nav_campo.title: Field - resultant
nav_campo.body: First BTC read: cycles, claim-cards, checks, filters and recent signals.
nav_campo.logic: Use this surface to see the current state before opening a specific lens.

nav_grafo.title: Graph - relations
nav_grafo.body: Relations across claims, timeframes, baselines and falsifier boundaries.
nav_grafo.logic: Use it to see which concepts are connected before reading a report.

nav_bicono.title: Bicone - poles
nav_bicono.body: Hypothesis poles extracted from readings: roots, singular, invariant and field of possibility.
nav_bicono.logic: Use it to read conceptual structure without treating it as an operating signal.

nav_agente.title: Agent - evidence
nav_agente.body: Full reports, verdicts, counter-pole flags and cycle trace.
nav_agente.logic: Use it when you need source text, falsification and runtime detail.

nav_tassonomia.title: Trajectory - movement
nav_tassonomia.body: Cycle sequence and regime-lab movement across time.
nav_tassonomia.logic: Use it to see whether the Lab is changing direction or repeating a pattern.

nav_prodotti.title: Products - SSP
nav_prodotti.body: Claim-cards, watchlist, reject reasons and checks.
nav_prodotti.logic: Use it to distinguish watch/test/reject from anything that is actually verified.

nav_info.title: Info - Lab map
nav_info.body: Where you are, what can be read and how the Lab turns BTC domain material into verifiable surfaces.
nav_info.logic: Use it for orientation before interpreting report or artifact content.

domain_modules.shows: Daily-computable BTC inefficiency candidates after method intake and field admissibility.

admin_actions.boundary: Run from current seed; no direction override without review.

forbidden_labels: manual chart annotations treated as evidence without mechanical definitions
Massimo Rea or Alipio methods treated as authority before observable/null/falsifier translation
current/open candle backtests unless explicitly declared as live-only observation
single-exchange wick or volume-profile result promoted without feed robustness

e2e.expectation: Completed cycle updates left, center and right surfaces.
Trace and falsifier visible before promotion.
